decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (FCP/87R/2015/D Revision 1, dated 12-11-2015; Design and Access Statement, unnumbered and undated; FCP/87R/2015/A Revision 1, dated 12-11-2015; - received 27/11/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the drawings hereby approved, this permission is for the erection of a single storey extension only and the rear garden area shall not be used for car parking or for vehicle access to Whitton Road and the paved forecourt area constructed shall be kept permanently available for car parking.
description: Retrospective application for a single storey rear extension to the house.
